summary: Completed frontend regression testing for the Panificadora Carvalho catalog and order flow. Logo, 24 catalog cards/images, category/search controls, cart, checkout, WhatsApp handoff, sent state, and mobile overflow all passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on the public URL at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. WhatsApp opens through the expected api.whatsapp.com redirect with customer/address payload intact; no horizontal overflow or page error messages were observed.
rca of the issue: The initial automation assertion expected the popup to remain on wa.me, but WhatsApp naturally redirected it to api.whatsapp.com. This was a test expectation issue, not an application defect; the final run validated the actual redirect and encoded order data.
